messages:
sarah-ops: incident-bot fired for canary-eu-probe — high flapping rate :rotating_light:

incident-bot: ALERT canary-eu-probe continuous_failures=3 region=eu-west-1

mike-sre: I'm paged. any customer impact reported?

devon-ml: sampling model responses, upstream returns 200. no increase in 5xx from the model. seeing latency blips that line up with probe times. probe-agent logs show deadline exceeded a few times.

sarah-ops: ok, live mitigation plan: suppress noisy alerts, investigate probe-agent. muting pager for canary-eu-probe for 30m to stop paging while we triage. /mute canary-eu-probe 30m — objections?

anya-pm: fine from PM side. customers reported no errors in support queue. sounds like monitoring noise.

mike-sre: doing quick checks — k8s cluster nodes healthy, no pod restarts for model infra. only the probe-agent instances have transient timeouts.

devon-ml: propose increasing probe timeout and lowering probe frequency, and widen the failure window so transient flaps don't trigger pages. also add a cheap health-check path that doesn't hit the full model to reduce probe cost.

sarah-ops: applying config change to staging first, then prod in eu. planned changes: 
```
# canary config snippet
frequency: 30s -> 120s
timeout: 2s -> 5s
consecutive_failures_threshold: 2 -> 4
use_lightweight_check: false -> true
```

mike-sre: rolled to staging, looks stable. now rolling to prod eu. updating alert rule to use sliding window (4 failures in 8 probes) instead of immediate 2/2.

mike-sre: updated grafana dashboard panel for canary success-rate and probe-agent latency (new panel id: canary-eu-5). sharing link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/canaries/canary-eu

oncall-bot: Pager muted for canary-eu-probe by sarah-ops for 30m (auto-unmute at +30m).

lee: taking handoff at 18:00 UTC. noted mute and config changes. will watch for recurrence overnight.

sarah-ops: quick customer-impact check: support queue = none, 5xx rate = normal, user-facing latency = within SLO. mark as monitoring-only incident for now.

anya-pm: pls add a retro tomorrow and a short note to release notes for the config tweak.

mike-sre: created follow-up ticket RF-2345: probe-agent circuit-breaker + lightweight-check rollout. also added a runbook snippet under oncall docs about temporarily muting noisy canaries and when to escalate.

devon-ml: will implement lightweight check and small backoff in probe logic (ETA 3 days).

sarah-ops: action items summary (added to the thread):
- probe frequency -> 120s (applied)
- timeout -> 5s (applied)
- contiguous failure threshold -> 4 (applied)
- new grafana panels + alert window change (applied)
- follow-up ticket for probe-agent changes (RF-2345)
- retro scheduled (anya)

mike-sre: no further pages after config change for last 45m. leaving mute to expire and watching.

sarah-ops: thanks all. closing this thread once mute expires and nightly check is clean. :thumbsup:
